# Strategus baseline fixture

- `strategus-baseline.json` — generated by running `generate-strategus-baseline.R`
  inside the `alp-dataflow-gen-worker` container.
- Confirmed Strategus version at generation time: 1.4.0 (re-verify with the
  `packageVersion("Strategus")` command in this task before regenerating —
  update this line if it has changed).
- Date generated: 2026-09-16
- Note: Strategus 1.4.0 exposes module specification builders via R6 module
  classes (e.g. `Strategus::CohortGeneratorModule$new()$createModuleSpecifications(...)`,
  `Strategus::CohortMethodModule$new()$createModuleSpecifications(...)`,
  `Strategus::PatientLevelPredictionModule$new()$createModuleSpecifications(...)`)
  and `Strategus::CohortGeneratorModule$new()$createCohortSharedResourceSpecifications(...)`
  for the cohort shared resource — not the free-function API
  (`Strategus::createCohortMethodModuleSpecifications(...)`, etc.) originally
  assumed. The generator script was adjusted accordingly. Also note the empty
  analysis specifications constructor is exported as
  `Strategus::createEmptyAnalysisSpecificiations()` (sic — extra "i", matches
  the actual exported name in this version).
- The resulting `AnalysisSpecifications`/`SharedResources`/module spec objects
  carry S3 classes with no `jsonlite::asJSON` method, so the script strips
  classes recursively before serializing (see `stripClasses()` in the
  generator script).
- Regenerate by `docker cp`-ing the script into `alp-dataflow-gen-worker`,
  running it via the pixi-env `Rscript` invocation documented in this task
  (plain `Rscript` does not work in this container — rJava needs
  `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` pointed at the bundled `libjvm.so`), then `docker cp` the
  output back into this directory.
